s0001.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on the wuchen new moon, because of the crown prince court congratulations were suspended.
s0001.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on the wuchen new moon of the first month of spring, court congratulations were suspended because of the crown prince.

s0002.literal: It was forbidden to carry gold, silver, and copper cash across the sea for mutual trade.
s0002.idiomatic: Carrying gold, silver, and copper cash across the sea for trade was forbidden.

s0003.literal: On jiaxu day the Emperor, because Japan was a solitary distant island barbarian state that heavily taxed the people's strength, halted the expedition against Japan, summoned Abaqchi to court, and likewise dispersed the civilian ships under his command.
s0003.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Emperor halted the expedition against Japan, judging the country a solitary distant island state that had overtaxed the people's strength. He summoned Abaqchi to court and dispersed the civilian ships under his command.

s0004.literal: Land from abolished monasteries in Jiangnan that had been occupied by others was all transferred to chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia to repair monasteries.
s0004.idiomatic: Land from abolished Jiangnan monasteries that others had seized was transferred to chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia to restore the monasteries.

s0005.literal: On jimao day post stations were established at Luobu, Qietai, Zheyang, and Woduan.
s0005.idiomatic: On jimao day post stations were established at Luobu, Qietai, Zheyang, and Woduan.

s0006.literal: Lü Wenhuan, right associate of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, requested retirement on grounds of age; this was granted, and his son was appointed pacification commissioner.
s0006.idiomatic: Lü Wenhuan, right associate of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, requested retirement on grounds of age; the request was granted and his son was appointed pacification commissioner.

s0007.literal: On gengchen day the kingdom of Ma-ba dispatched envoys presenting copper shields.
s0007.idiomatic: On gengchen day the kingdom of Ma-ba sent envoys presenting copper shields.

s0008.literal: On renwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0008.idiomatic: On renwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0009.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice on the Emperor's behalf at the mountains, rivers, and Eastern Sea.
s0009.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and Eastern Sea in the Emperor's stead.

s0010.literal: On guiwei day the twenty-four-city monopoly offices of Gongchang were abolished, and the matter was transferred to regular officials.
s0010.idiomatic: On guiwei day Gongchang's twenty-four-city monopoly offices were abolished and the work transferred to regular officials.

s0011.literal: Five thousand ingots of paper currency were issued to purchase grain at Sha, Jing, and Longxing.
s0011.idiomatic: 5,000 ingots of paper currency were issued to purchase grain at Sha, Jing, and Longxing.

s0012.literal: Following Sangge's request, Yang Lianzhenjia was ordered to send Song imperial clansmen Xie Yisun, Quan Yunjian, Zhao Yi, and Zhao Taiyi as hostages.
s0012.idiomatic: At Sangge's request, Yang Lianzhenjia was ordered to send Song imperial clansmen Xie Yisun, Quan Yunjian, Zhao Yi, and Zhao Taiyi as hostages.

s0013.literal: On jiashen day Hudu'er said: "Two hundred newly submitted garrison-farming troops under my command have dug a canal at Yijinai; the labor has been long and the task vast; I ask that nearby civilians and surplus households of Western monks assist the work.
s0013.idiomatic: On jiashen day Hudu'er said, "Two hundred newly submitted garrison-farming troops under my command have dug a canal at Yijinai; the labor has been long and the task vast. I ask that nearby civilians and surplus households of Western monks assist."

s0015.literal: Hansun dispatched envoys saying: "More than eight hundred exhausted soldiers ask for relief and provisioning; it would be appropriate to verify the truth at the Duoludu sea station.
s0015.idiomatic: Hansun sent envoys saying, "More than 800 exhausted soldiers ask for relief and provisioning; their claims should be verified at the Duoludu sea station."

s0016.literal: " The Emperor said: "Sending men there recently would already have been too late; have them provisioned directly.
s0016.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Sending men there now would already be too late; provision them directly."

s0017.literal: " On dinghai day the spurious yin-yang book 《Manifest Brightness Calendar》 was burned.
s0017.idiomatic: On dinghai day the spurious yin-yang text 《Manifest Brightness Calendar》 was burned.

s0018.literal: On xinmao day Ala Haiya and others were ordered to deliberate on matters related to the campaign against Annam.
s0018.idiomatic: On xinmao day Ala Haiya and others were ordered to deliberate on the campaign against Annam.

s0019.literal: On guisi day Changxi County of Fuzhou was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fu'an and Ningde counties placed under it.
s0019.idiomatic: On guisi day Changxi County of Fuzhou was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fu'an and Ningde counties placed under it.

s0020.literal: On bingshen day one thousand newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm the vacant lands east of Hesihan Pass; the government supplied farm implements and seed oxen.
s0020.idiomatic: On bingshen day 1,000 newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm vacant lands east of Hesihan Pass; the government supplied farm implements and seed oxen.

s0021.literal: On dingyou day the imperial carriage hunted in the near suburbs.
s0021.idiomatic: On dingyou day the imperial carriage hunted near the capital.

s0022.literal: Xu Prefecture was reduced to a county and placed under the Man-Yi pacification commission.
s0022.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture was reduced to a county and placed under the Man-Yi pacification commission.

s0023.literal: An edict forbade interference with the salt tax.
s0023.idiomatic: An edict forbade interference with the salt tax.

s0024.literal: Review officials were established on all routes to examine criminal cases; two on upper routes, one on lower routes.
s0024.idiomatic: Review officials were established on all routes to examine criminal cases: two on upper routes and one on lower routes.

s0025.literal: Wuning County of Longxing was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fenning placed under it.
s0025.idiomatic: Wuning County of Longxing was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fenning placed under it.

s0026.literal: Second month, on jihai day, an edict was issued throughout court and countryside: all Han commoners possessing iron rules, hand maces, and staffs with hidden blades were to deliver them to the government.
s0026.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, an edict ordered that throughout court and countryside all Han commoners possessing iron rules, hand maces, and staffs with hidden blades deliver them to the government.

s0027.literal: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched with five thousand ingots of paper currency to relieve the famine commoners under Prince Xiaoxue.
s0027.idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were sent with 5,000 ingots of paper currency to relieve famine commoners under Prince Xiaoxue.

s0028.literal: On jiachen day Xuexuedejin was made left grand councillor of the Burma branch secretariat, Atai Dong'a associate administrator, and Udusmish secretary of branch secretariat affairs.
s0028.idiomatic: On jiachen day Xuexuedejin was made left grand councillor of the Burma branch secretariat, Atai Dong'a associate administrator, and Udusmish secretary of branch secretariat affairs.

s0029.literal: Ala Haiya was retained as left grand councillor of the Annam branch secretariat; Orluchi grand councillor; commander-in-chief Umar, Yili Mish, Ali, Zanshun, and Fan Ji all associate administrators.
s0029.idiomatic: Ala Haiya was retained as left grand councillor of the Annam branch secretariat; Orluchi was made grand councillor; and commander-in-chief Umar, Yili Mish, Ali, Zanshun, and Fan Ji were all made associate administrators.

s0030.literal: Envoys were dispatched to instruct Prince Yesen Temur to mobilize one or two or three thousand Helazhang troops and deliver them to Ala Haiya for the Jiaozhi campaign; the names of officers and soldiers were also to be reported.
s0030.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to instruct Prince Yesen Temur to mobilize 1,000 to 3,000 Helazhang troops for Ala Haiya's Jiaozhi campaign and report the names of officers and soldiers.

s0031.literal: On yisi day court deliberation held that in the northeast, princes' domains were intermixed with others' populations and pacification commissions carried insufficient weight; the Shanbei Liaodong Circuit and Kaiyuan Route pacification commissions were abolished and the Eastern Capital branch secretariat was established, with Kuokkuonitudun as left grand councillor, Liaodong pacification commissioner Tachu as right associate, privy council secretary Yang Renfeng and pacification commissioner Yiersaghan as associate administrators.
s0031.idiomatic: On yisi day the court decided that in the northeast princes' domains were intermixed with other populations and pacification commissions carried too little weight. The Shanbei Liaodong Circuit and Kaiyuan Route pacification commissions were abolished and the Eastern Capital branch secretariat established, with Kuokkuonitudun as left grand councillor, Liaodong pacification commissioner Tachu as right associate, and privy council secretary Yang Renfeng and pacification commissioner Yiersaghan as associate administrators.

s0032.literal: An edict to the Central Secretariat said: "Gold and silver stored by the Palace Storehouse Directorate are to be distributed to princes according to former-court precedent.
s0032.idiomatic: An edict to the Central Secretariat said, "Gold and silver stored by the Palace Storehouse Directorate are to be distributed to princes according to former-court precedent."

s0033.literal: " The Grand Agriculturist Directorate was re-established to manage exclusively agriculture and sericulture.
s0033.idiomatic: The Grand Agriculturist Directorate was re-established to manage agriculture and sericulture exclusively.

s0034.literal: The Imperial Provision Directorate was raised to rank two; Zhenchao Fu was reduced to Chao Prefecture.
s0034.idiomatic: The Imperial Provision Directorate was raised to rank two, and Zhenchao Fu was reduced to Chao Prefecture.

s0035.literal: On dingwei day, following censorate officials' memorial, regulations were established for surveillance commissioners touring counties; aside from two commissioners remaining at headquarters, deputy commissioners and below each year in the second month would proceed to inspect and govern and return to headquarters in the tenth month.
s0035.idiomatic: On dingwei day, following censorate officials' memorial, regulations were established for surveillance commissioners touring counties: aside from two commissioners remaining at headquarters, deputy commissioners and below would each year in the second month proceed to inspect and govern and return in the tenth month.

s0036.literal: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon Jing.
s0036.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon Jing.

s0037.literal: On wushen day the Privy Council memorialized: "Previously dispatched ten thousand Mongol troops for garrison-farming obtained, beyond annual expenses, three thousand ingots of paper currency from grain sales; I ask that this be distributed from the granary to poor garrison troops in the various wings.
s0037.idiomatic: On wushen day the Privy Council memorialized, "Ten thousand Mongol troops previously dispatched for garrison-farming obtained, beyond annual expenses, 3,000 ingots of paper currency from grain sales; I ask that this be distributed from the granary to poor garrison troops in the various wings."

s0038.literal: " The Emperor was pleased and ordered it carried out as convenient.
s0038.idiomatic: The Emperor was pleased and ordered it carried out as convenient.

s0039.literal: Two thousand newly submitted troops of the capital were deployed in camps for garrison-farming.
s0039.idiomatic: 2,000 newly submitted troops of the capital were deployed in camps for garrison-farming.

s0040.literal: On guichou day Daning County of Xi Prefecture was re-established.
s0040.idiomatic: On guichou day Daning County of Xi Prefecture was re-established.

s0041.literal: On dingsi day the Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to build three hundred sea vessels for the Jiaozhi campaign, to assemble at Qin and Lian prefectures in the eighth month.
s0041.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to build 300 sea vessels for the Jiaozhi campaign and assemble them at Qin and Lian prefectures in the eighth month.

s0042.literal: On wuwu day the four Jiangnan branch privy councils were merged into branch secretariats.
s0042.idiomatic: On wuwu day the four Jiangnan branch privy councils were merged into branch secretariats.

s0043.literal: The Jinghu-Zhancheng branch secretariat general was ordered to use sixty thousand troops from the Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi branch secretariats to attack Jiaozhi.
s0043.idiomatic: The Jinghu-Zhancheng branch secretariat general was ordered to use 60,000 troops from the Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi branch secretariats to attack Jiaozhi.

s0044.literal: Orluchi, grand councillor of the Jinghu branch secretariat, asked to come to audience regarding the Jiaozhi campaign; an edict ordered him to proceed to court by official courier.
s0044.idiomatic: Orluchi, grand councillor of the Jinghu branch secretariat, asked to come to audience regarding the Jiaozhi campaign; an edict ordered him to proceed to court by official courier.

s0045.literal: Academician-expositor Cheng Wenhai of the Hall of Worthies said: "Provincial secretariat bureaus and agencies all employ southerners jointly, but the censorate and surveillance commissions do not.
s0045.idiomatic: Academician-expositor Cheng Wenhai of the Hall of Worthies said, "Provincial secretariat bureaus and agencies all employ southerners jointly, but the censorate and surveillance commissions do not."

s0046.literal: Southern custom is what southerners know; it would be convenient to employ them jointly.
s0046.idiomatic: Southern custom is what southerners know; it would be convenient to employ them jointly.

s0047.literal: " The Emperor spoke of this to Yusutemur, who replied: "Capable men should be selected and reported.
s0047.idiomatic: The Emperor spoke of this to Yusutemur, who replied, "Capable men should be selected and reported."

s0048.literal: " The Emperor said: "Are all Han officials you employ necessarily capable?
s0048.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Are all Han officials you employ necessarily capable?"

s0049.literal: " School lands on Jiangnan routes had formerly all been placed under the government; an edict restored them to the original schools to facilitate teaching and nurture.
s0049.idiomatic: School lands on Jiangnan routes had formerly all been placed under the government; an edict restored them to the original schools to facilitate teaching and nurture.

s0050.literal: Chen Yiji was enfeoffed as king of Annam and Chen Xiuyuan as Duke of Assisting Righteousness; an edict was also issued instructing Annam officials and commoners.
s0050.idiomatic: Chen Yiji was enfeoffed as king of Annam and Chen Xiuyuan as Duke of Assisting Righteousness; an edict was also issued instructing Annam officials and commoners.

s0051.literal: The Yue, E, Changde, Tanzhou, and Jingjiang tea monopoly offices were re-established.
s0051.idiomatic: The Yue, E, Changde, Tanzhou, and Jingjiang tea monopoly offices were re-established.

s0052.literal: On guihai day the Astronomical Observatory submitted the 《Calendar Canon of the Shou Shi Era》 and 《Calendrical Discourse》; an edict ordered them stored in the Hanlin Imperial Historiography Academy.
s0052.idiomatic: On guihai day the Astronomical Observatory submitted the 《Calendar Canon of the Shou Shi Era》 and 《Calendrical Discourse》; an edict ordered them stored in the Hanlin Imperial Historiography Academy.

s0053.literal: On jiazi day Plains Prefecture duke Zhao Yourui's Jiangnan land was again placed under the Eastern Palace, and the Ganzhou branch secretariat was established.
s0053.idiomatic: On jiazi day Plains Prefecture duke Zhao Yourui's Jiangnan land was again placed under the Eastern Palace, and the Ganzhou branch secretariat was established.

s0054.literal: On bingyin day, for compiling land registers, Qufu professor Chen Yan, Jingzhao's Xiao, and Yu Yinglong of Shu were summoned; only Yinglong came to the capital.
s0054.idiomatic: On bingyin day, to compile land registers, Qufu professor Chen Yan, Jingzhao's Xiao, and Yu Yinglong of Shu were summoned; only Yinglong came to the capital.

s0055.literal: Third month, on jisi day, censorate officials said: "Recently, following an imperial order, surveillance commissions were to employ southerners jointly, which is not within our knowledge; attendant censor Cheng Wenhai, handling branch censorate affairs, should together with branch censorate officials broadly gather reputable men of public integrity and report their names.
s0055.idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi day, censorate officials said, "Recently, following an imperial order, surveillance commissions were to employ southerners jointly, which is not within our knowledge; attendant censor Cheng Wenhai, handling branch censorate affairs, should together with branch censorate officials broadly gather reputable men of public integrity and report their names."

s0056.literal: " The Emperor ordered an edict sent forth.
s0056.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered an edict sent forth.

s0058.literal: The Zhongxing Route canals were dredged and repaired.
s0058.idiomatic: The Zhongxing Route canals were dredged and repaired.

s0059.literal: The Yunhe Office was merged into the Music Office.
s0059.idiomatic: The Yunhe Office was merged into the Music Office.

s0060.literal: On xinwei day Mei and Xun were reduced to lower prefectures.
s0060.idiomatic: On xinwei day Mei and Xun were reduced to lower prefectures.

s0061.literal: On jiaxu day Xiong, Ba, and the counties of Baoding were flooded, inundating official and private fields; troops and civilians were mobilized to build river dikes for defense.
s0061.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xiong, Ba, and the counties of Baoding were flooded, inundating official and private fields; troops and civilians were mobilized to build river dikes.

s0062.literal: On yihai day Maishuding was retained as right associate of the Central Secretariat; he and Guo You jointly managed revenue and grain; Yang Jukuan handled appointments.
s0062.idiomatic: On yihai day Maishuding was retained as right associate of the Central Secretariat; he and Guo You jointly managed revenue and grain, and Yang Jukuan handled appointments.

s0063.literal: The Qipchaq Imperial Guard Command was established.
s0063.idiomatic: The Qipchaq Imperial Guard Command was established.

s0064.literal: Prince Tuhu Temur was granted twenty thousand sheep.
s0064.idiomatic: Prince Tuhu Temur was granted 20,000 sheep.

s0065.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0065.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0066.literal: An edict ordered branch censorate surveillance commissioners to tour counties in the eighth month.
s0066.idiomatic: An edict ordered branch censorate surveillance commissioners to tour counties in the eighth month.

s0067.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "During Ahmad's time, the cost of provisions for princes and imperial sons-in-law traveling back and forth was all taken from the Treasury of Myriad Myriads; afterward officials' salaries were levied to repay it, which was extremely inconvenient.
s0067.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "During Ahmad's time, provisions for princes and imperial sons-in-law traveling back and forth were all taken from the Treasury of Myriad Myriads; afterward officials' salaries were levied to repay it, which was extremely inconvenient."

s0068.literal: " An edict ordered those on the registers exempted from collection.
s0068.idiomatic: An edict ordered those on the registers exempted from collection.

s0069.literal: Li Qinan, tea monopoly commissioner, was made Jiangxi tea transport commissioner.
s0069.idiomatic: Li Qinan, tea monopoly commissioner, was made Jiangxi tea transport commissioner.

s0070.literal: Qinan had once said: "Jiangnan tea was three guan six hundred wen per certificate; now each certificate should be increased to five guan.
s0070.idiomatic: Qinan had once said, "Jiangnan tea was 3 guan 600 wen per certificate; now each certificate should be raised to 5 guan."

s0071.literal: " The matter was referred to the Central Secretariat for deliberation; accordingly Qinan was made transport commissioner, with a darughachi placed above him.
s0071.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Central Secretariat for deliberation; accordingly Qinan was made transport commissioner, with a darughachi placed above him.

s0072.literal: On dingchou day the Eastern Capital branch secretariat was moved to Xianping Prefecture.
s0072.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Eastern Capital branch secretariat was moved to Xianping Prefecture.

s0073.literal: On guisi day Jupiter encroached upon Leibi Formation.
s0073.idiomatic: On guisi day Jupiter encroached upon Leibi Formation.

s0074.literal: Linjiang Route was made fief of the Prince of Beian.
s0074.idiomatic: Linjiang Route was made fief of the Prince of Beian.

s0075.literal: Summer, fourth month, on gengzi day, Central Secretariat officials requested establishment of the Bianliang branch secretariat and Yan-South, Hedong, and Shandong pacification commissions.
s0075.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, Central Secretariat officials requested establishment of the Bianliang branch secretariat and Yan-South, Hedong, and Shandong pacification commissions.

s0076.literal: An order said: "Nanjing has a sparse population and theft has ceased; there is no need to establish a secretariat; the pacification commissions may be established as requested.
s0076.idiomatic: An order said, "Nanjing has a sparse population and theft has ceased; there is no need to establish a secretariat; the pacification commissions may be established as requested."

s0077.literal: Jinan is Prince Shengnahe'er's fief, and Taiyuan is Prince Azhiji's fief; each prince is to appoint one official to govern jointly.
s0077.idiomatic: Jinan is Prince Shengnahe'er's fief and Taiyuan is Prince Azhiji's fief; each prince is to appoint one official to govern jointly.

s0078.literal: " An edict exempted Mongol garrison-farming troops of Yunnan campaigning against Jiaozhi from land rent.
s0078.idiomatic: An edict exempted Mongol garrison-farming troops of Yunnan campaigning against Jiaozhi from land rent.

s0079.literal: The Wumeng post station was established.
s0079.idiomatic: The Wumeng post station was established.

s0080.literal: Revenue and grain of all Jiangnan routes were all placed under the Central Secretariat.
s0080.idiomatic: Revenue and grain of all Jiangnan routes were placed under the Central Secretariat.

s0081.literal: Nasir al-Din, grand councillor of Yunnan Province, submitted several expedient measures: first, relax road prohibitions and allow common people to come and go;
s0081.idiomatic: Nasir al-Din, grand councillor of Yunnan Province, submitted several expedient measures: first, relax road prohibitions and allow common people to come and go;

s0082.literal: second, forbid peddlers and not allow them to follow campaigns;
s0082.idiomatic: second, forbid peddlers from following campaigns;

s0083.literal: third, abolish Dandang station levies of gold from the people for food and drink expenses;
s0083.idiomatic: third, abolish Dandang station levies of gold from the people for food and drink expenses;

s0084.literal: fourth, allow the people to fell timber for trade;
s0084.idiomatic: fourth, allow the people to fell timber for trade;

s0085.literal: fifth, warn envoys not to disturb private dwellings and establish urgent-dispatch stations to economize on courier mounts.
s0085.idiomatic: fifth, warn envoys not to disturb private dwellings and establish urgent-dispatch stations to economize on courier mounts.

s0086.literal: An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.
s0086.idiomatic: An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.

s0087.literal: On xinchou day the Shaanxi branch secretariat said: "At Yan'an garrison-farming was established under the Hawking Office directorate; deserting troops of Huoshibuhua's army all entered garrison-farming; now they are again supplying horses for Prince of Qin Anxige's follower Aheidas and rendering other taxes.
s0087.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Shaanxi branch secretariat said, "At Yan'an garrison-farming was established under the Hawking Office directorate; deserting troops of Huoshibuhua's army all entered garrison-farming; now they are again supplying horses for Prince of Qin Anxige's follower Aheidas and rendering other taxes."

s0088.literal: " An order abolished all of this; those who did not reform were to be punished by death.
s0088.idiomatic: An order abolished all of this; those who did not reform were to be punished by death.

s0089.literal: On jiachen day the branch censorate was moved from Hangzhou to Jiankang.
s0089.idiomatic: On jiachen day the branch censorate was moved from Hangzhou to Jiankang.

s0090.literal: The surveillance commissions of Shannan, Huai-East, and Huai-West circuits were placed under the inner censorate.
s0090.idiomatic: The surveillance commissions of Shannan, Huai-East, and Huai-West circuits were placed under the inner censorate.

s0091.literal: The number of semuren surveillance censors at the branch censorate was increased.
s0091.idiomatic: The number of semuren surveillance censors at the branch censorate was increased.

s0092.literal: On dingwei day the Jiangdong pacification commission presented one stalk of lingzhi fungus.
s0092.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Jiangdong pacification commission presented one stalk of lingzhi fungus.

s0093.literal: On gengxu day posthumous-title regulations were promulgated.
s0093.idiomatic: On gengxu day posthumous-title regulations were promulgated.

s0094.literal: On renzi day Nasir al-Din of the Privy Council said: "Five thousand young conscript troops previously under my command went to campaign against Damaguo; their strength is already exhausted; now princes are again registering these troops for the Burma campaign; action should be taken after inquiry.
s0094.idiomatic: On renzi day Nasir al-Din of the Privy Council said, "Five thousand young conscript troops previously under my command went to campaign against Damaguo; their strength is already exhausted; now princes are again registering these troops for the Burma campaign; action should be taken after inquiry."

s0095.literal: " The Emperor said: "If their strength is not yet impaired, send them at once.
s0095.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "If their strength is not yet impaired, send them at once."

s0096.literal: " Nasir al-Din was still instructed to detach one thousand Alazhang and Mongol troops under a capable minister and send them to Jiaozhi to assist Prince Tuohan.
s0096.idiomatic: Nasir al-Din was still instructed to detach 1,000 Alazhang and Mongol troops under a capable minister and send them to Jiaozhi to assist Prince Tuohan.

s0097.literal: On jiwei day Yaochumu was dispatched to audit Jinghu branch secretariat revenue and grain.
s0097.idiomatic: On jiwei day Yaochumu was dispatched to audit Jinghu branch secretariat revenue and grain.

s0098.literal: The Central Secretariat proposed making Yaochumu grand councillor and Tuotuohu associate administrator.
s0098.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat proposed making Yaochumu grand councillor and Tuotuohu associate administrator.

s0099.literal: An order said: "Yaochumu is a petty man who has served me only five years; appointing him a single accounting official is enough.
s0099.idiomatic: An order said, "Yaochumu is a petty man who has served me only five years; appointing him a single accounting official is enough."

s0100.literal: Tuotuohu is a slave's slave fit only for clerk or messenger.
s0100.idiomatic: Tuotuohu is a slave's slave fit only for clerk or messenger.
